units.source_text: “听说是德国还是哪个国家，有一百二十七位妇女做人工妊娠手术，

en.t: I heard that in Germany, or some other country, one hundred and twenty-seven women underwent artificial insemination,

units.source_text: 其中五十二人当上了母亲，尽管成功率远比牛马低，

en.t: and fifty-two of them became mothers; although the success rate was far lower than with cattle or horses,

units.source_text: 但也达到了百分之四十一。
此外我还听说这么一件事，据说某个尼姑庵的深处，有个处女尼姑怀孕了。

en.t: Besides that, I also heard this story: they say that deep inside a certain convent, a virgin nun became pregnant.

units.source_text: 据说她因为残疾才当尼姑的，说是从来未见过男人的脸，竟……”

en.t: They say she became a nun because of a disability, and that she had never even seen a man's face, and yet..."
